question: Where’s the closest golf course in the direction of south starting from SCL Health Saint Joseph Hospital, Denver, CO?
sql: WITH hospital AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%SCL Health Saint Joseph Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Denver%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CO%' LIMIT 1 ), golf_courses AS ( SELECT poi_name AS name, geometry FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, geometry FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' ) SELECT gc.name FROM golf_courses gc, hospital h WHERE degrees(ST_Azimuth(h.geometry, gc.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5 -- South direction ORDER BY ST_Distance(h.geometry::geography, gc.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;

metadata.final_exec_err: ST_Azimuth(geography, geography) is only valid for point inputs
